description:
Explore San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Park, with tons of sights and landmarks along with its beautiful bike paths! This 2-hour electric bike tour is perfect for the beginner, as they breeze past Hippie Hill, the Gardens, and other historical landmarks! Unlimited Biking will arm you with all you need for your adventure - a guide, helmet, bike bag, all free of charge – you just supply the need to explore!

We are located right outside of the park where you will meet your guide and get fitted for your bike before heading out. Our comfortable Cannondale eBikes minimize the pedaling, so you can focus on what really matters - exploring San Francisco's Golden Gate Park!
Golden Gate Park is hands-down one of the best places to ride in San Francisco with so many places to see, from museums and to gardens to a herd of lazy buffalo. Inside this 1000+ acre park, riders will see the Arboretum Botanical Gardens, Japanese Tea Gardens, Hippie Hill, the Bison Paddock and so much more!

Electric bikes are for individuals 16+.

---

**Tour Times:**
2PM Daily

**Pricing:** 
Adults - Starting at $65 | 16+

**Tips**
Dress appropriately  for the weather and don't forget your camera!
